say: Ninety-nine percent of your weight is pure energy.
Zoom into any atom in your body. Nearly all of its weight sits in the core. Protons and neutrons.
Inside each one: three tiny quarks.
But weigh the quarks alone, and you get about one percent of the proton.
The other ninety-nine percent is energy. Quarks in furious motion, gripped by the strongest force in nature.
And energy has weight. That is E equals M C squared.
Even the famous Higgs field only gives you that one percent.
So step on a scale. Seventy kilograms. Without the energy, less than one would be left.
You are not really made of solid stuff. You are energy, trapped since the first second of the universe.
